params.message:
Symfony 8.1.12 for seven advisories published on 25 November 2026

composer audit --locked fails every pull request since the advisories for symfony/http-kernel,
mailer, routing and serializer (CVE-2026-133743, -133746, -133751, -133752, -133754, -133755,
-133761) came out; all are fixed in 8.1.12. http-foundation moves along because http-kernel
8.1.12 requires it. Lock file only, patch releases.
